drift.label: Drift
drift.question: Is the average moving?
drift.method: Seasonal OLS with month dummies, Newey-West HAC(12) errors; Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery correction across all fitted series

erratic.label: Erratic
erratic.question: Are the swings getting bigger?
erratic.method: Trend in the absolute size of deseasonalised, detrended monthly anomalies; Newey-West HAC(12); Benjamini-Hochberg across all places and variables.
erratic.caveat: For rain and runoff, swings naturally grow when the average grows; read alongside drift.

conflict.label: Conflict
conflict.question: Do independent NASA systems disagree?
conflict.method: Rain: MERRA-2 (POWER) vs GPM IMERG. Soil: MERRA-2 topsoil wetness vs GLDAS soil moisture. Contradicted = both significant, opposite directions. Contested = one significant, the other points the other way.

migrate.label: Migrate
migrate.question: Does this place's climate now resemble somewhere else?
migrate.method: Analogue search on 12 monthly means of temperature, rain, humidity and topsoil wetness: 2020-24 at each place vs 2000-04 at all 360.
migrate.caveat: About 49 places 'move' over just 5 years from weather noise alone, so any single match is a lead, not a finding.

resilience.label: Early warning
resilience.question: Is it losing the ability to bounce back?
resilience.method: Rising lag-1 autocorrelation in 10-year windows (critical slowing down), AR(1) surrogates, Benjamini-Hochberg.
resilience.note: Watched, nothing detected: raw hits are at the rate expected by chance.
